title: RLEF: Grounding Code LLMs in Execution Feedback with Reinforcement Learning

live_model.evidence: Table 2 row "gpt-4o-2024-05-13 25.3 24.3 82.8 80.7 68.8 71.7" (1@3 solve rates, single-turn / multi-turn on CodeContests test, HumanEval+, MBPP+); "Solve rates estimated on 20 rollouts per problem, temperature 0.2".

prompt.note: Single-turn setting needs only the initial prompt; multi-turn appends execution feedback.

claim.metric: 1@3 solve rate (%) on CodeContests test, single-turn
claim.location: Table 2, row gpt-4o-2024-05-13, column CC. Test ST

notes: Soft gap: solve rates require executing generated programs against the CodeContests private tests (public harness) and 20 rollouts per problem to estimate 1@3. gpt-4o is a comparison baseline; the paper's subject is RLEF-trained Llama models.

resolution.plan: Scoring is execution-based but needs no authors' code: the CodeContests test split (165 problems) ships public, private and generated tests, and Appendix C.1 prints the single-turn prompt with ${problem} replaced by the problem statement verbatim. Sample 20 solutions per problem from gpt-4o-2024-05-13 at temperature 0.2 / top-p 0.95, run each in a sandbox against the private and generated tests, and compute 1@3 with the Li et al. (2022) unbiased estimator (Table 2 caption).
resolution.approximation: Sandbox time/memory limits and the number of tests executed per problem may differ from the authors' setup; 3,300 calls per seed.
